extraction.Name: So lon Cries For Rib
extraction.Buyer: The purchaser, John Carson & Son, agreed to pay $2500 for the land, but only $100 was paid on the sale
extraction.Occupation/Income: Allottee has absolutely no source of income
extraction.NOTES: Patent was receipted for; $50 mortgage which allottee never paid, nor was settlement demanded; good health but poor eyesight, no money accumulated; no contributions made toward his support from Government, State, or County; patent delivered at Agency office; document dated June 18, 1928; file reference 61391
